name: Hur
title: Moses' Faithful Supporter
summary: Hur was a prominent Israelite who, along with Aaron, supported Moses during the battle against the Amalekites. He was also entrusted with leadership responsibilities alongside Aaron when Moses went up Mount Sinai. Jewish tradition links him to Miriam as her husband.

keyEvents.title: Supported Moses' Hands in Battle
keyEvents.description: During Israel's battle against the Amalekites, Hur and Aaron held up Moses' hands so that Israel could prevail. As long as Moses kept his hands raised, Israel won.

keyEvents.title: Appointed to Lead the People
keyEvents.description: When Moses went up Mount Sinai to receive the law, Hur was appointed along with Aaron to settle disputes for the people in his absence.

keyEvents.title: Bezalel's Grandfather
keyEvents.description: He was the grandfather of Bezalel through his son Uri. Bezalel was chosen by God and filled with wisdom to lead the work on the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: From the tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: Hur belonged to the tribe of Judah and was thus part of the lineage that would later lead to King David and the Messiah.
